title: SUPERSEDED by schema/cp2_case.schema.json (strict Draft 2020-12). Kept as Phase 1 documentation of the CP2 extension fields.
description: Documentation schema. Enforcement: sou13cp2/records.py (record_errors) and sou13cp2/leakage.py. CP1 fields, labels (true/false/null, known_mask, unknown, contract_view, label_evidence), provenance and digests are kept byte-for-byte; CP1 records on disk are never rewritten (the CP2 view is built in memory).

family_id.description: One implementation of tool behaviour, admitted under one or more (server_id, tool_name) identities.

template_id.description: Case-construction pattern inside the family; its structural signature must be unique in the taxonomy.

alias_group_id.description: All identities/normalised names of the family.

leakage_group_id.description: Connected component of the leakage graph; unit of split assignment (from the manifest).

exposure.description: cp1_shared / v02_derived are pinned to train.

kind.description: sou13_pilot_v02 is rejected: v0.2 is analysis input only.

cp1_record_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical CP1 record; any change to CP1 fields is detected.
